name: Waris Shah
contribution: An 18th-century Punjabi Muslim Sufi poet of the Chishti order, known for his contribution to Punjabi literature.
legacy: He is primarily known as the author of the best known rendition of Heer Ranjha, one of the most popular tragic romances of Punjab.

checks.lead: Waris Shah (Punjabi: وارث شاہ  (Shahmukhi); 1722 – 1798) was an 18th-century Punjabi Muslim Sufi poet of the Chishti order, known for his contribution to Punjabi literature.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
